attributes.action: Hold a national referendum on the legalisation of assisted dying in the UK
attributes.additional_details: A public referendum would provide a clear, democratic mandate on this issue, ensuring that every citizen has a voice in shaping the laws governing the end of life. The government has previously stated it has no plans for a referendum, arguing it is a matter for Parliament. However, given the deep public interest, we urge the Government to give the public the final say.
attributes.background: Introduce legislation to hold a UK-wide, legally binding public referendum on whether to legalise assisted dying for terminally ill, mentally competent adults - this should be a public decision not parliament.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject, which you may wish to sign: 

Hold a referendum on assisted dying
